✓ Elections in France.question: The specified times are in the time zone of the district, which is uniform (Paris time) across _____, but varies in French overseas territories such as French Guiana, Martinique and Guadeloupe
✓ Elections in France.fact: The specified times are in the time zone of the district, which is uniform (Paris time) across Metropolitan France, but varies in French overseas territories such as French Guiana, Martinique and Guadeloupe. Due to their different time zones, voters in some overseas territories previously knew the probable results of elections before the polling booths in Metropolitan France had closed, which could have discouraged voter participation in these places.
